# Nora

## Appearance

Nora is a resident of Andrews' Cove who is characterized by her physical features. She has black hair accompanied by black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)_

## History

Nora is an imaginary rock person created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), who considers her the first of his fictional rock companions and loves her the best. [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) invents magical adventures about Nora and his other imaginary shore friends, describing tales where they sail into moonglades and visit the sunset land. He later writes about these fantastical journeys in a letter while clarifying that the stories are purely from his imagination.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P45](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0045), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P46](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0046), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P3](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0003), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P6](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0006), +21 more_
